rationale: Evidence e2 (a People/Billboard exclusive) directly identifies the target: Bada Lee is the South Korean dancer/choreographer who led Team BEBE and won Street Woman Fighter 2 (SWF2) and is famous for the 'Smoke' challenge. Evidence e3 states Smoke Remix (and thus the SWF2 song Smoke) is a track 'by Dynamic Duo, Zico, B.I, Jay Park, Changmo, Jessi and Padi' — so Smoke is partly produced by Padi. Combined, this unambiguously identifies that the person who popularized the dance routine for a song partly produced by Padi is Bada Lee. Answer supported; no gaps.
